title: Componentwise pinned derived pullback square comparison
statement: Let f:X→S, f′:X′→S′, g:S′→S and g′:X′→X be scheme morphisms [def-pc-scheme] with g′≫f=f′≫g. On the supplied derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], construct a natural transformation Lg*⋙Lf′*→Lf*⋙Lg′* [def-pc-derived-pullback]. Its component at M is c(f′,g).hom(M), followed by equality transport for the commuting square on the object M, followed by c(g′,f).inv(M), where c is exactly the original pinned family [def-pc-t2-open-pinned-composition]. Naturality follows from the original composition transformations and the equality transport, using eqToHom_app. This construction uses no additional choice or existence witness.
